policy.selection: Select exactly the original frozen rank 2 when present. No SP, market, edge or odds filter; no replacement after a withdrawal.
policy.ranking: Family frozen logits plus full-field softmax. Turf uses competition rank for equal probabilities. AW, Hurdle and Chase break ties by ascending runner ID.
policy.eligibility: Validated complete pre-off current-generation primary books, unique race IDs, original active runners at capture. Reference money requires both original T1 and T2 to be priced starters in a reconciled final field.
policy.settlement: canonical_settlement_v3 final fractional Sporting Life SP, £1 win stakes, split dead-heat credit and gross return, no stake for NR/void/unresolved. Market expectation is normalized over actual starters.
